speakers.audio_profile: Danny Ruiz, 38, a night security guard and single dad. Warm, a little gravelly, with a dry sense of humor. He is telling the story of the worst night of his life, quietly, like it still shakes him.

dialogue_turns.text: [whispers] The dead man pressing his face against my gate used to be my best friend. [tense] In about ten seconds, the radio clipped to his chest is going to crackle... and tell every one of them exactly where I'm hiding. [pause] [wry] My name is Danny Ruiz. I'm the night security guard at Maplecrest Mall. And yes, I've heard every mall cop joke there is.

scene: Late at night. Danny sits alone in the dark and tells what happened in the first hour of a zombie outbreak at the shopping mall where he works. Intimate and close to the microphone, no music.
sample_context: A first-person survival story told as a YouTube narration.
